name: Model 2 - risk that the next annual inspection finds a defect, by system
target: defect found at the NEXT annual inspection (about 12 months ahead) of the same vehicle, by system; NOT a breakdown and NOT a failure forecast

systems.electrical: lighting and signalling, battery, wiring (mostly lamps)
systems.engine_emissions: exhaust emissions, fuel system, mounts, leaks (not engine health)

coverage.makes: makes outside the list are mapped to OTHER (lower evidence)

training_data.primary: UK DVSA MOT (OGL v3.0), 1-in-41 vehicle sample, test in 2022 -> next test in 2023
training_data.mileage_estimated_by_model1: not used: no gain in any experiment (notebooks 07, 09)

bands.higher: score above the 80th percentile of vehicles of the same age (cross-fitted UK scores)

limitations: foreign (UK/NL) vehicles and inspections: not validated on Israeli vehicles
target is an inspection defect found about a year later, not a breakdown
absolute probabilities are calibrated to UK base rates and shift between countries (e.g. electrical 11% UK against 18% NL): shown as relative risk
history variants need the previous INSPECTION result; maintenance records are not equivalent and are not used as such
XGBoost and Logistic Regression perform equally within the noise of the splits
discrimination is modest: a risk ranking, not a diagnosis
